name: recover_javascript_sources
description: Recover readable modules from one local UTF-8 JavaScript script/bundle into an absent directory, using caller-supplied Wakaru ^1.13.0 (verified with 1.14.0) on Linux x64. Returns original/derived digests, extraction byte ranges, emitted source maps, warnings and analysis_input inline. Structural splitting may fall back to one module; original names and runtime equivalence remain unknown. No application code execution. Requires util-linux prlimit; one worker, 1 GiB address-space ceiling, 120-second deadline, 64 MiB input, 128 MiB output, 10000 entries and 8 MiB per diagnostic/report stream.

__schema0.description: Absolute path to a UTF-8 JavaScript file; never executed

__schema2.description: Absolute absent output directory; parent must exist

__schema3.description: Structural module boundaries, heuristic fallback, or finer inspection-only regions

__schema5.description: Upstream syntax recovery level; runtime equivalence remains unverified
